📦 WHAT GETS BUILT

5 Complete Bootable ISO Files (~10-12 GB total):

Edition              Size    Purpose                    Best For
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Comprehensive        3.5 GB  Full stack, all projects   Complete development
Microkernel          1.5 GB  Lightweight                Resource-constrained
Mobile               1.8 GB  Mobile-optimized           Mobile development
VMware               2.0 GB  Virtualization opt.        VM deployment
Standard             2.5 GB  Default edition            General use

Each ISO includes:
  ✓ BIOS/MBR bootloader (legacy systems)
  ✓ UEFI/GPT bootloader (modern systems)
  ✓ Live system (read-only)
  ✓ Install mode (read-write)
  ✓ Complete development toolchain
  ✓ All 13 integrated GitHub projects
  ✓ SHA256 + MD5 checksums

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🚀 QUICK START (3 COMMANDS)

1. Windows PowerShell (as Administrator):
   cd C:\tmp\ChimeraIIOS

2. Start generation:
   .\generate-all-iso-editions-wsl2.ps1

3. Wait 3-5 hours for all editions to complete...

Output: $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\ChimeraIIOS-ISOs\
        ├── ChimeraIIOS-comprehensive-1.0.0-x86_64.iso
        ├── ChimeraIIOS-microkernel-1.0.0-x86_64.iso
        ├── ChimeraIIOS-mobile-1.0.0-x86_64.iso
        ├── ChimeraIIOS-vmware-1.0.0-x86_64.iso
        ├── ChimeraIIOS-standard-1.0.0-x86_64.iso
        └── (all checksums included)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✅ PREREQUISITES

System Requirements:
  • Windows 10/11 with WSL2
  • Ubuntu 20.04+ on WSL2
  • Docker installed on WSL2
  • 50GB+ free disk space
  • 8GB+ RAM (16GB recommended)
  • 4+ CPU cores
  • 3-5 hours available time

Verify:
  wsl --version                    # WSL2
  wsl docker --version             # Docker
  wsl df -h /                      # Disk space (need 50GB+)
  wsl docker images | findstr chimera  # Docker images

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📋 BUILD PROCESS (13 STEPS PER EDITION)

For each of 5 editions:

1.  Check prerequisites
2.  Verify Docker image
3.  Create build directories
4.  Export Docker image to rootfs (~5-10 min)
5.  Create bootloader config
6.  Create GRUB images (BIOS + UEFI)
7.  Extract kernel & initrd
8.  Create squashfs filesystem (~10-20 min)  ⏱️ Longest step
9.  Add branding & metadata
10. Generate ISO image (~5-10 min)
11. Generate checksums (SHA256, MD5)
12. Generate build report
13. Cleanup temporary files

Result: 5 bootable ISOs + checksums + build report

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

After 3-5 hours:

Also on WSL2:
  /root/build-iso-editions/iso-output/  (same files)
  /root/build-iso-editions/logs/        (build logs per edition)
  /root/build-iso-editions/build.log    (master log)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🔥 BURNING TO USB

Option 1: Rufus (Windows) - Recommended
  1. Download: https://rufus.ie/
  2. Open Rufus
  3. Device: Select USB drive
  4. Boot: Click "Select", choose ISO
  5. Click "START"
  6. Done in 5-10 minutes

Option 2: balena Etcher (All Platforms)
  1. Download: https://balena.io/etcher/
  2. Select ISO file
  3. Select USB drive
  4. Click "Flash"
  5. Done in 5-10 minutes

Option 3: dd (WSL2)
  lsblk                                    # List drives
  sudo dd if=ChimeraIIOS-*.iso of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress
  sync

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🖥️ BOOT FROM USB

1. Insert USB drive into computer
2. Restart computer
3. During startup, press F12, DEL, or ESC (varies by computer)
4. Select USB drive from boot menu
5. Press Enter
6. Wait for OS to load (~30-60 seconds)

Boot Menu Options (when OS loads):
  • Live System (read-only, safe testing)
  • Install Mode (read-write)
  • Safe Mode (no GPU drivers)
  • Diagnostics
  • Reboot
  • Power Off

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🧪 TEST BEFORE BURNING (Optional)

QEMU (WSL2):
  sudo apt install qemu-system-x86-64
  qemu-system-x86_64 -cdrom ChimeraIIOS-comprehensive-1.0.0-x86_64.iso -m 4G

VirtualBox:
  1. Create new VM
  2. Set CD-ROM to ISO
  3. Power on

VMware:
  1. Create new VM
  2. Attach ISO as CD-ROM
  3. Power on

🐛 TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Insufficient disk space
  wsl df -h /              # Check space (need 50GB+)
  wsl docker system prune -a  # Clean Docker

Problem: Docker image not found
  wsl docker images        # Check if images exist
  cd /mnt/c/tmp/ChimeraIIOS
  wsl docker build -f Dockerfile.comprehensive -t chimera2os:latest .

Problem: Permission denied
  Script requires sudo - already handled by PowerShell wrapper

Problem: Build takes too long
  Normal! Squashfs compression takes 10-20 min per edition
  Just wait - script doesn't timeout

Problem: ISO won't boot
  1. Verify checksum: sha256sum -c *.sha256 (in WSL2)
  2. Re-burn to USB with Rufus
  3. Try BIOS vs UEFI mode (ISO has both)
  4. Try different USB drive

Problem: Can't find output files
  WSL path: \\wsl$\Ubuntu\root\build-iso-editions\iso-output\
  Or: wsl ls -lh /root/build-iso-editions/iso-output/

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

💡 TIPS & TRICKS

Speed up build:
  • Use SSD (not HDD) for WSL2
  • Allocate more CPUs to WSL2 in .wslconfig
  • Close other applications
  • Use WSL2 Gen 2 (newer systems)

Monitor build progress:
  In separate terminal: wsl tail -f /root/build-iso-editions/build.log

Copy ISOs manually:
  powershell
  Copy-Item "\\wsl$\Ubuntu\root\build-iso-editions\iso-output\*.iso" `
    -Destination $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\

Verify checksum:
  cd ~/build-iso-editions/iso-output
  sha256sum -c *.sha256
  md5sum -c *.md5

🎬 NEXT STEPS

1. VERIFY PREREQUISITES (5 min)
   wsl --version
   wsl docker --version
   wsl df -h /
   wsl docker images | findstr chimera

2. START GENERATION (3-5 hours)
   cd C:\tmp\ChimeraIIOS
   .\generate-all-iso-editions-wsl2.ps1

3. MONITOR PROGRESS
   Watch console output (auto-updating with progress)

4. WHEN COMPLETE (after 3-5 hours)
   ISOs automatically copied to Downloads\ChimeraIIOS-ISOs\
   Checksums verified
   Build report generated

5. BURN TO USB (5-10 min)
   Download Rufus: https://rufus.ie/
   Select ISO and USB drive
   Click START

6. BOOT AND ENJOY! 🎉
   Insert USB
   Restart computer
   Select USB from boot menu
   Wait for OS to load
